caption: Stills taken from the three movies (frames 0, 360 and 720 of 721, i.e. t = 0, 9 and 18 τ of the NVE production run; the camera orbits from azimuth 25° to 65° over the movie): (a) the neutral control (1000 hard spheres, η = 0.35), (b) the charged run in the opaque CPK style (20 red + and 20 blue − ions, l_B = 5 σ), of which only the ions near the three camera-facing faces are visible, and (c) the same charged frames in the x-ray style with the neutrals 85 % transparent, which shows all 40 ions and their contact pairs inside the box.
